name: ivory-coast-vat
description: Use this skill to prepare, review or explain a Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast) VAT or TVA return for 2026. It covers who must charge VAT by regime, the 18% and 9% rates, exemptions and the 2026 changes for factoring and animal feed, the taxable base and when VAT falls due, mobile money deductibility, refunds of credits, monthly deadlines by taxpayer type, non-resident digital platforms and supplier classification on bank statements. Trigger on "TVA Côte d'Ivoire", "DGI return", "e-impots", "VAT Ivory Coast", "FNE", "crédit de TVA". ALWAYS read it before handling Ivory Coast VAT work. It is for businesses, accountants and foreign platforms selling into the country.
